integrity.claim_scope: The Lie normal form, all-arity joint-centralizer polynomial, all-arity commuting counts, and explicit nonisomorphic/non-anti-isomorphic examples are proved directly.
integrity.computation: Standalone standard-library exhaustive checks on selected prime fields; finite checks are not a proof for every field.

limitations: Height-one forest posets only; cycles and longer chains are outside the proof.
Novelty of all-arity formula assessed against located sources but an unlocated stronger source is possible.
The first-order rank spectrum and commuting-pair probability are known specializations and not separately claimed as new.
title: Forest incidence algebras have a universal commutator Lie reduct and all-arity centralizer spectra
